acceptance_criteria.statement: Implement independent approval and deterministic policy authority has executable implementation and behavior-specific automated verification.
Security state remains truthful, upstream-first, traceable, and repository-valid.

definition_of_done: Implementation is present and locally behaviorally verified.
Relevant security requirements/test/evidence mappings are current.
External tools remain explicit adapter/blocked states until live-qualified.
Plaintext secret material is never persisted.
description: Implement independent approval and deterministic policy authority. The implementation is local, typed, evidence-backed, and does not claim live external scanner/vault/signing verification.
exclusions: No plaintext secret material in repository state or evidence.
No live external scanner, vault, or signing claim without executed evidence.
objective: Implement independent approval and deterministic policy authority
observability_impact: Security decisions, leases, findings, provenance, and audit events are structured and queryable.
rationale: Pass 17 implements security authority and supply-chain controls while preserving Project Pipeline deterministic authority and explicit external-verification boundaries.
rollback_recovery_consideration: Preserve audit/evidence history; revoke affected grants/leases and roll back code/schema without rewriting prior observed security state.
security_impact: Directly changes security authority, credential release, egress, CI, supply-chain, or root-of-trust controls.
title: Implement independent approval and deterministic policy authority
